description: The Analyst's meaning-making workflow: document(s) in, a multi-step method, text + tables + figures out. Eight recorded steps; step 4 is an executor sub-plan of 1-4 engine phases (numbered 4.1, 4.2, …) whose prose feeds the later steps.

phases.phase_description: Read every document (1M-context path when large): a DocumentProfile per document (genre, thesis, key claims with verbatim anchors, entities, tensions) and a corpus map (shared questions, disagreements).
Exactly three angles (tellings) with executable engines, cost/time estimates and output shape; status becomes awaiting_brief unless autopilot.

A WorkflowExecutionPlan restricted to executable engines (capability YAML present). Depth policy: simple = 1 engine × 1 pass, medium = 2-3 engines chained, advanced = 3-4 engines + synthesis. Records strategy_rationale and alternatives_considered.
Runs the plan through the executor as sub-phases 4.1, 4.2, … (one engine each, every phase receiving the prior phases' prose as context). Sub-job events are mirrored into the dossier's event stream.
2-3 evidence tables with verbatim anchors per row; the anchor wall drops rows whose quotes are not in the source text.
A figure plan of N depictable scenes, rendered through the images contract; optional (skip law).
Sections with footnoted anchors in the audience's register; Jinja2 HTML → PDF (weasyprint) → Markdown, with a 'How this was made' appendix.
Every LLM/image call receipted (model, tokens, cost, duration, prompt/result hashes); totals on the job.

output_description: dossier.html, dossier.pdf, dossier.md under DOSSIER_DIR/<job_id>/, plus tables, figures, receipts and the full event ledger.
